title: Muse Spark 1.1
summary: Muse Spark 1.1 is Meta's latest image generation and editing API model, offering developers high-quality AI-powered visual content creation capabilities through a developer-friendly interface with comprehensive evaluation benchmarks and integration resources.
problem_solved: Enables developers to integrate state-of-the-art AI image generation and editing capabilities into their applications without building models from scratch.
why_valuable: Provides accessible, enterprise-grade image generation API from a major tech company, democratizing AI-powered visual content creation for developers worldwide.
